source: lane T3 live copy of J2b's Arsenal job (v0.1.27, the MEGA sentence sent once at 22:03): the quick cartridge diff of event 1261 (reports/cartridge-a1-s1261.json structured output) and events 1255-1262

diff.why: Any skater who lands a body check goes MEGA for five seconds. That means you, your teal Tide Otters bot mates and the red Crane Gulls bots. A mega skater is twice as heavy and a little faster, and every bump knocks a man flat. He turns wide, so a quick skater can slip past the red giants. After five seconds he goes back to normal. The meteor on F stays as it is. No key can say the white flash, the boing, the pop, the doubled size, the MEGA! and FLATTENED! text, the camera shake or the trembling ice, so a builder has to add those.

events.text: Add a Mario Kart Mega Mushroom you earn with a big hit, like NHL Hitz: any skater, me or a bot, who lands a body check goes MEGA for five seconds. He flashes white with a boing and balloons to twice his size, with MEGA! big over him (and in the middle of the screen when it is me). While mega he is twice as heavy and a bit faster, every bump knocks a man flat with a thud, FLATTENED! and a little camera shake, and the ice trembles under his strides; but he turns wide, so a quick skater can slip past him. After five seconds he shrinks back with a pop. The rival bots go mega whenever they land a check on me or my mates, so I must dodge their giants, and my bot mates go mega too. Keep the meteor on F as it is.
